H7001.derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H7000 (קָטַר);
H7001.def: a knot (as tied up), i.e. (figuratively) a riddle; also a vertebra (as if a knot)

H7009.def: an opponent (as rising against one), i.e. (collectively) enemies

H7013.derivation: from H6969 (קוּן) in the original sense of fixity;

H7014.derivation: the same as H7013 (קַיִן) (with a play upon the affinity to H7069 (קָנָה));
H7014.def: Kajin, the name of the first child, also of a place in Palestine, and of an Oriental tribe

H7015.def: a dirge (as accompanied by beating the breasts or on instruments)

H7017.derivation: or קִינִי; (1 Chronicles 2:55), patronymic from H7014 (קַיִן);
H7017.def: a Kenite or member of the tribe of Kajin

H7018.derivation: from the same as H7064 (קֵן); fixed;

H7019.def: harvest (as the crop), whether the product (grain or fruit) or the (dry) season

H7023.derivation: or קִר; (Isaiah 22:5), or (feminine) קִירָה; from H6979 (קוּר);
H7023.def: a wall (as built in a trench)

H7024.def: Kir, a place in Assyrian; also one in Moab

H7025.derivation: or (feminine of the latter word) קִיר חֲרֶשֶׂת; from H7023 (קִיר) and H2789 (חֶרֶשׂ); fortress of earthenware;
H7025.def: Kir-Cheres or Kir-Chareseth, a place in Moab

H7026.derivation: or קֵרֹס; from the same as H7166 (קַרְסֹל); ankled;

H7027.def: Kish, the name of five Israelites

H7033.derivation: a primitive root (rather identical with H7034 (קָלָה) through the idea of shrinkage by heat);
H7033.def: to toast, i.e. scorch partially or slowly

H7034.def: to be light (as implied in rapid motion), but figuratively, only (be (causatively, hold) in contempt)
H7034.kjv: base, contemn, despise, lightly esteem, set light, seem vile.

H7037.derivation: apparently but a form for H6747 (צַלַּחַת);

H7042.def: Kelita, the name of three Israelites

H7043.def: to be (causatively, make) light, literally (swift, small, sharp, etc.) or figuratively (easy, trifling, vile, etc.)
H7043.kjv: abate, make bright, bring into contempt, (ac-) curse, despise, (be) ease(-y, -ier), (be a, make, make somewhat, move, seem a, set) light(-en, -er, -ly, -ly afflict, -ly esteem, thing), [idiom] slight(-ly), be swift(-er), (be, be more, make, re-) vile, whet.

H7049.def: to sling; also to carve (as if a circular motion, or into light forms)

H7050.def: a sling; also a (door) screen (as if slung across), or the valve (of the door) itself

H7053.derivation: from an unused root meaning to prick;

H7054.derivation: feminine of active participle of H6965 (קוּם);
H7054.def: something that rises, i.e. a stalk of grain

H7055.derivation: from H6965 (קוּם) and H410 (אֵל); raised of God;
H7055.def: Kemuel, the name of a relative of Abraham, and of two Israelites

H7056.def: Kamon, a place East of the Jordan

H7057.derivation: or קִימוֹשׁ; from an unused root meaning to sting;

H7058.derivation: from an unused root probably meaning to grind;

H7064.def: a nest (as fixed), sometimes including the nestlings; figuratively, a chamber or dwelling

H7065.def: to be (causatively, make) zealous, i.e. (in a bad sense) jealous or envious
H7065.kjv: (be) envy(-ious), be (move to, provoke to) jealous(-y), [idiom] very, (be) zeal(-ous).

H7069.def: to erect, i.e. create; by extension, to procure, especially by purchase (causatively, sell); by implication to own
H7069.kjv: attain, buy(-er), teach to keep cattle, get, provoke to jealousy, possess(-or), purchase, recover, redeem, [idiom] surely, [idiom] verily.

H7070.def: a reed (as erect); by resemblance a rod (especially for measuring), shaft, tube, stem, the radius (of the arm), beam (of a steelyard)
H7070.kjv: balance, bone, branch, calamus, cane, reed, [idiom] spearman, stalk.

H7071.def: Kanah, the name of a stream and of a place in Palestine

H7073.derivation: probably from an unused root meaning to hunt; hunter;
H7073.def: Kenaz, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites

H7074.def: a Kenizzite or descendant of Kenaz

H7075.def: creation, i.e. (concretely) creatures; also acquisition, purchase, wealth
H7075.kjv: getting, goods, [idiom] with money, riches, substance.

H7076.derivation: from an unused root (meaning to erect);

H7077.derivation: a primitive root; to erect; but used only as denominative from H7064 (קֵן);
H7077.def: to nestle, i.e. build or occupy as anest

H7078.derivation: from an unused root probably meaning to wrench;

H7079.def: Kenath, a place East of the Jordan

H7080.def: properly, to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll; by implication, to divine

H7081.def: a lot; also divination (including its fee), oracle

H7083.derivation: from the same as H3563 (כּוֹס) (or as H7185 (קָשָׁה));
H7083.def: properly, a cup, i.e. an ink-stand

H7084.derivation: perhaps from H7049 (קָלַע) in the sense of enclosing; citadel;

H7087.def: to shrink, i.e. thicken (as unracked wine, curdled milk, clouded sky, frozen water)

H7090.derivation: or קִפֹּדlemma קִכֹּד kaf, corrected to קִפֹּד; from H7088 (קָפַד);
H7090.def: a species of bird, perhaps the bittern (from its contracted form)

H7091.derivation: from an unused root meaning to contract, i.e.
H7091.def: spring forward; an arrow-snake (as darting on its prey)

H7092.def: to draw together, i.e. close; by implication, to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically, to die (from gathering up the feet)
H7092.kjv: shut (up), skip, stop, take out of the way.

H7093.def: an extremity; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after

H7095.def: shape (as if cut out); base (as if there cut off)

H7096.def: to cut off; (figuratively) to destroy; (partially) to scrape off

H7097.derivation: or (negative only) קֵצֶה; from H7096 (קָצָה); (used in a great variety of applications and idioms; compare H7093 (קֵץ))
H7097.kjv: [idiom] after, border, brim, brink, edge, end, (in-) finite, frontier, outmost coast, quarter, shore, (out-) side, [idiom] some, ut(-ter-) most (part).

H7099.derivation: and (feminine) קִצְוָה; from H7096 (קָצָה); (used like H7097 (קָצֶה), but with less variety)
